title: Virk advises the Galileo Project and the Sol Project
place_text: Galileo Project; Sol Project at Stanford

tellings.quote: I'm I'm an advisor to the Galileo Project and peripherally involved with the Sol Project as well at Stanford.

plain: An MIT scientist named Rizwan Virk says that in the 2020s he has advised the Galileo Project, a scientific effort to study unexplained objects, and has been loosely involved in the Sol Project, a similar effort at Stanford. He tells Michels: "I'm an advisor to the Galileo Project and peripherally involved with the Sol Project as well at Stanford." It matters because it shows established universities taking up the subject.
